description: Defines the StorageUnit class interface, a parent class for all cells and modules, including general functions and virtual methods for battery management and thermal modeling.

classes.name: slide::StorageUnit
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a general interface for storage units, including methods for state management, electrical and thermal properties, and data handling.

methods.name: calculateNcells
methods.description: Returns the number of cells connected to this storage unit (default implementation returns 0).

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns the identification string of the storage unit.

methods.name: setID
methods.description: Sets the identification string of the storage unit.

methods.name: getFullID
methods.description: Returns the full ID including parent module ID.

methods.name: Cap
methods.description: Pure virtual function to get the capacity of the storage unit.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the parent storage unit.

methods.name: I
methods.description: Pure virtual function to get the current.

methods.name: getRtot
methods.description: Pure virtual function to get total resistance.

methods.name: getNcells
methods.description: Pure virtual function to get number of connected cells.

methods.name: isCharging
methods.description: Checks if the storage unit is charging (current < 0).

methods.name: isDischarging
methods.description: Checks if the storage unit is discharging (current > 0).

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves the current states into a provided container.

methods.name: viewStates
methods.description: Returns a view of the current states.

methods.name: setBlockDegAndTherm
methods.description: Sets whether degradation and thermal ODEs are ignored.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current with optional checks.

methods.name: setVoltage
methods.description: Sets the voltage with optional checks, uses utility function.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Calculates thermal model based on neighbors.

methods.name: validStates
methods.description: Checks if current states are valid.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the storage unit.
